```{r}
dat <- read_excel("/Users/wangenyou/Desktop/EFR 590 Meta/Metaofai7.xlsx")
library(robumeta)

# Factor
dat$Source <- factor(dat$Source, levels = c("AI", "Human"))
dat$Type   <- factor(dat$Type, levels = c("3", "4"))

# Accuracy → proportion
dat$p <- dat$Accuracy / 100

# 避免 0 / 1
dat$p_adj <- ifelse(dat$p == 0, 0.5 / dat$Sample,
             ifelse(dat$p == 1, (dat$Sample - 0.5) / dat$Sample, dat$p))

# Logit effect size
dat$yi <- qlogis(dat$p_adj)

# Variance
dat$Correct <- round(dat$p_adj * dat$Sample)
dat$vi <- 1 / dat$Correct + 1 / (dat$Sample - dat$Correct)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 3. Leave-one-out sensitivity: Model 1
# Source effect, all data
# -------------------------

studies <- unique(dat$StudyID)

loo_source <- lapply(studies, function(s) {
  temp <- subset(dat, StudyID != s)
  
  fit <- robu(
    yi ~ Source,
    data = temp,
    studynum = StudyID,
    var.eff.size = vi,
    modelweights = "CORR",
    rho = 0.8,
    small = TRUE
  )
  
  data.frame(
    removed_study = s,
    beta_SourceHuman = fit$reg_table$b.r[fit$reg_table$labels == "SourceHuman"],
    SE = fit$reg_table$SE[fit$reg_table$labels == "SourceHuman"],
    p = fit$reg_table$prob[fit$reg_table$labels == "SourceHuman"],
    CI_L = fit$reg_table$CI.L[fit$reg_table$labels == "SourceHuman"],
    CI_U = fit$reg_table$CI.U[fit$reg_table$labels == "SourceHuman"]
  )
})

loo_source <- do.call(rbind, loo_source)
print(loo_source)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------
# 0. 準備資料（Genre 設定）
# ---------------------------------
dat_ai$Genre <- factor(dat_ai$Genre)
dat_ai$Genre <- relevel(dat_ai$Genre, ref = "Classroom")  # baseline

# ---------------------------------
# 1. Leave-one-out setup
# ---------------------------------
studies_ai <- unique(dat_ai$StudyID)

loo_genre <- lapply(studies_ai, function(s) {
  
  temp <- subset(dat_ai, StudyID != s)
  
  # ---------------------------------
  # 2. RVE meta-regression
  # ---------------------------------
  fit <- robu(
    yi ~ Genre,
    data = temp,
    studynum = StudyID,
    var.eff.size = vi,
    modelweights = "CORR",
    rho = 0.8,
    small = TRUE
  )
  
  # ---------------------------------
  # 3. 抓係數（兩個 moderator）
  # ---------------------------------
  coef_table <- fit$reg_table
  
  # 安全抓值（避免某些 LOO 沒出現某 level）
  get_val <- function(label, col) {
    if (label %in% coef_table$labels) {
      return(coef_table[[col]][coef_table$labels == label])
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(
    removed_study = s,
    
    # --- Journal vs Classroom ---
    beta_Journal = get_val("GenreJournal", "b.r"),
    SE_Journal   = get_val("GenreJournal", "SE"),
    p_Journal    = get_val("GenreJournal", "prob"),
    CI_L_Journal = get_val("GenreJournal", "CI.L"),
    CI_U_Journal = get_val("GenreJournal", "CI.U"),
    
    # --- Recommendation vs Classroom ---
    beta_Rec = get_val("GenreRecommendation", "b.r"),
    SE_Rec   = get_val("GenreRecommendation", "SE"),
    p_Rec    = get_val("GenreRecommendation", "prob"),
    CI_L_Rec = get_val("GenreRecommendation", "CI.L"),
    CI_U_Rec = get_val("GenreRecommendation", "CI.U")
  )
})

# ---------------------------------
# 4. 合併結果
# ---------------------------------
loo_genre <- do.call(rbind, loo_genre)

print(loo_genre)
```

```{r}
library(metafor)

res_bias <- rma(yi, vi, data = dat, method = "REML")

# Funnel plot
funnel(res_bias)

# Egger's test
k <- res_bias$k
n_studies <- length(unique(dat$StudyID))
egger <- regtest(res_bias, model = "rma")

cat("Egger's test (k =", k, "effect sizes, studies =", n_studies, 
    "): z =", round(egger$zval, 3),
    ", p =", round(egger$pval, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(metafor)

# Study-level aggregation
dat_agg <- aggregate(
  cbind(yi, vi) ~ StudyID,
  data = dat,
  FUN = mean
)

# Random-effects model
res_bias_agg <- rma(
  yi = yi,
  vi = vi,
  data = dat_agg,
  method = "REML"
)

# Funnel plot
funnel(res_bias_agg)

# Egger's test
k <- res_bias_agg$k
egger <- regtest(res_bias_agg, model = "rma")

cat("Study-level Egger's test (k =", k, "studies): z =",
    round(egger$zval, 3),
    ", p =", round(egger$pval, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# weighted mean function
w_mean <- function(x, w) sum(x * w) / sum(w)

# 分組計算
summary_table <- dat %>%
  group_by(Type, Source) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy = w_mean(p_adj, Sample),
    N = sum(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Type, Source)

Summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    SE = sqrt(Accuracy * (1 - Accuracy) / N),
    CI_low = Accuracy - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_high = Accuracy + 1.96 * SE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CI_low = pmax(CI_low, 0),
    CI_high = pmin(CI_high, 1)
  )

summary_table
```

```{r}
compute_sdt <- function(df){

  p_AI    <- df$Accuracy[df$Source == "AI"]
  p_Human <- df$Accuracy[df$Source == "Human"]

  H  <- p_AI
  FA <- 1 - p_Human

  # 避免 0/1
  H  <- pmin(pmax(H, 0.001), 0.999)
  FA <- pmin(pmax(FA, 0.001), 0.999)

  zH  <- qnorm(H)
  zFA <- qnorm(FA)

  d_prime <- zH - zFA
  c_bias  <- -0.5 * (zH + zFA)

  data.frame(
    Hit = H,
    False_Alarm = FA,
    d_prime = d_prime,
    c = c_bias
  )
}

# 分 GPT3 / GPT4 算
sdt_3 <- compute_sdt(filter(summary_table, Type == "3"))
sdt_4 <- compute_sdt(filter(summary_table, Type == "4"))

sdt_3$Type <- "3"
sdt_4$Type <- "4"

sdt_table <- bind_rows(sdt_3, sdt_4) %>%
  select(Type, Hit, False_Alarm, d_prime, c)

sdt_table
```

```{r}
make_forest_plot <- function(dat_sub, main_title) {
  
  n <- nrow(dat_sub)
  rows <- n:1
  
  # observed proportion and 95% CI
  est <- transf.ilogit(dat_sub$yi)
  lb  <- transf.ilogit(dat_sub$yi - 1.96 * sqrt(dat_sub$vi))
  ub  <- transf.ilogit(dat_sub$yi + 1.96 * sqrt(dat_sub$vi))
  
  # 右側顯示文字
  acc_text <- sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f%%, %.1f%%]",
                      est * 100,
                      lb * 100,
                      ub * 100)
  
  par(mar = c(5, 6, 3, 6), cex = 0.9)
  par(xpd = NA)
  
  forest(
    x = dat_sub$yi,
    vi = dat_sub$vi,
    transf = transf.ilogit,
    slab = NA,
    rows = rows,
    xlim = c(-1.7, 1.7),
    alim = c(0, 1),
    at = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    refline = 0.5,
    psize = 1.1,
    cex = 0.8,
    col = "black",
    annotate = FALSE,
    header = FALSE,
    xlab = "Accuracy (%)",
    main = "",
    xaxt = "n"
    )
  
  axis(
    side = 1,
    at = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 20), "%")
    )
  
  text(
    x = 0.3,
    y = n + 3,
    labels = main_title,
    cex = 1.2,
    font = 2
   )
  
  # 左側標題
  text(
    x = -1.20,
    y = n + 2.0,
    labels = "Study Name",
    pos = 4,
    font = 2,
    cex = 0.8,
    col = "black"
  )
  
  # 左側研究名稱
  text(
    x = -1.20,
    y = rows,
    labels = dat_sub$label,
    pos = 4,
    cex = 0.8,
    col = "black"
  )
  
  # 右側標題
  text(
    x = 1.02,
    y = n + 2.0,
    labels = "Accuracy [95% CI]",
    pos = 4,
    font = 2,
    cex = 0.8,
    col = "black"
  )
  
  # 右側數值
  text(
    x = 1.02,
    y = rows,
    labels = acc_text,
    pos = 4,
    cex = 0.8,
    col = "black"
  )
}
make_forest_plot(dat_ai, "ChatGPT-generated")
make_forest_plot(dat_human, "Human-written")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# =========================
# 1. 整理資料
# =========================

dat_base <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.character(Type),
    p = Accuracy / 100
  )

# 找出沒有標記版本的共用 Human baseline
shared_human <- dat_base %>%
  filter(
    Source == "Human",
    is.na(Type)
  )

# 僅為繪圖用途，將共用 baseline 放入兩個版本
shared_human_versions <- bind_rows(
  shared_human %>% mutate(Type = "3"),
  shared_human %>% mutate(Type = "4")
)

dat_plot <- dat_base %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type)) %>%
  bind_rows(shared_human_versions) %>%
  mutate(
    Version = case_when(
      Type == "3" ~ "GPT-3.5",
      Type == "4" ~ "GPT-4"
    ),
    Version = factor(
      Version,
      levels = c("GPT-3.5", "GPT-4")
    ),
    Source = factor(
      Source,
      levels = c("AI", "Human")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Version))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# =========================
# 1. Study-level data
# =========================

study_accuracy <- dat_plot %>%
  group_by(StudyID, Version, Source) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy = weighted.mean(
      Accuracy,
      Sample,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================
# 2. Pooled estimates + 95% CI
# =========================

pooled_accuracy <- dat_plot %>%
  group_by(Version, Source) %>%
  summarise(
    total_n = sum(Sample, na.rm = TRUE),
    correct = sum((Accuracy / 100) * Sample, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = correct / total_n,

    logit_est = qlogis(estimate),

    se = sqrt(
      1 / correct +
      1 / (total_n - correct)
    ),

    lower = plogis(logit_est - 1.96 * se),
    upper = plogis(logit_est + 1.96 * se),

    Estimate = estimate * 100,
    Lower = lower * 100,
    Upper = upper * 100
  )

pooled_accuracy
```

```{r}
# =========================
# SDT values
# =========================

sdt_values <- tibble(
  Version = c("GPT-3.5", "GPT-4"),
  dprime = c(0.48, 0.06),
  criterion_c = c(0.24, 0.05)
) %>%
  mutate(
    human_mean = 0,
    ai_mean = dprime,

    # criterion location on evidence axis
    criterion = criterion_c + dprime / 2
  )


# =========================
# Distribution data
# =========================

distribution_data <- sdt_values %>%
  group_split(Version) %>%
  map_dfr(function(x) {

    evidence <- seq(
      -3.5,
      3.5,
      length.out = 800
    )

    tibble(
      Version = x$Version,
      Evidence = evidence,

      Human = dnorm(
        evidence,
        mean = x$human_mean,
        sd = 1
      ),

      AI = dnorm(
        evidence,
        mean = x$ai_mean,
        sd = 1
      )
    )
  }) %>%

  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AI, Human),
    names_to = "Source",
    values_to = "Density"
  )
```

```{r}
p_distribution <- ggplot(

  aes(

    y = Density,

) +

  geom_area(
    alpha = 0.55,
    position = "identity"
  ) +

  # =========================

  geom_segment(
    data = sdt_values,
    aes(
      x = human_mean,
      xend = human_mean,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0.39
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = sdt_values,
    aes(
      x = ai_mean,
      xend = ai_mean,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0.39
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # =========================
  # d-prime arrow
  # =========================

  geom_segment(
    data = sdt_values,
    aes(
      x = human_mean,
      xend = ai_mean,
      y = 0.43,
      yend = 0.43
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    arrow = arrow(
      ends = "both",
      type = "closed",
      length = unit(0.10, "cm")
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = sdt_values,
    aes(
      x = (human_mean + ai_mean) / 2,
      y = 0.475,
      label = paste0("d′ = ", dprime)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.5
  ) +

  # =========================
  # Decision criterion
  # Orange dashed line
  # =========================

  geom_segment(
    data = sdt_values,
    aes(
      x = criterion,
      xend = criterion,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0.35
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "#D55E00"
  ) +

  # Response bias label
  geom_text(
    data = sdt_values,
    aes(
      x = criterion + 0.12,
      y = 0.32,
      label = paste0("c = ", criterion_c)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.8,
    color = "#D55E00",
    hjust = 0
  ) +

  # =========================
  # Facets
  # =========================

  facet_wrap(
    ~Version,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "AI" = "#E69F00",
      "Human" = "#56B4E9"
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 0.50),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  # =========================
  # Labels
  # =========================

  labs(
    title = "Theoretical Signal Detection Distributions",

    subtitle = paste0(
      "Black solid lines indicate distribution means; ",
      "orange dashed lines indicate estimated decision criteria"
    ),

    x = "Decision Evidence (Human-like \u2190 \u2192 AI-like)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Text Source"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 21,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 17,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

p_distribution
```
